protocol.evaluation_population: All 63036 development cells across 4 donor folds; legacy donors and external final excluded
protocol.training_budget: 4096 outer-training cells for all improvement controls; a separate matched training-budget condition from the 12000-cell A-series, never reuse A-series scores as the improvement baseline
protocol.validation_policy: same D0 capped inner-validation IDs within each seed/fold; data sampling modifies only training; final refit uses six outer-training donors
protocol.initial_screen: fold0 seed42 only; choose via inner-validation fixed-six macroF1, no external scores
protocol.confirmation: seeds42,43,44 on all4 donor folds for selected data/model candidates and paired controls

hypotheses.observed_pattern: Geneformer donor common-ontology F1 varies 0.8435–0.9507; donor sizes vary 3368–13770 cells in full development OOF
hypotheses.candidate_explanation: Natural sampling overrepresents larger donors; unequal donor information may hurt transfer
hypotheses.planned_change: D1_donor_balanced: approximately equal training cells per donor, without replacement, exact same total cells as D0
hypotheses.fixed_components: Same base features, logistic head family, D0-selected C/class_weight, train cell count, validation/evaluation cell IDs
hypotheses.primary_metric_and_direction: Pooled fixed-six macroF1 increase; donor paired direction reported
hypotheses.negative_control: D0 natural uniform random sample with equal total cell count
hypotheses.success_or_rejection_rule: Exploratory selection by inner-validation macroF1; confirm benefit only if pooled mean improves and >=5/8 donor mean deltas nonnegative across seeds; otherwise report no benefit

factorial_policy: Use selected training-data candidate and best partial/LoRA candidate against frozen identical NN head for 2x2. If candidates do not improve, retain negative comparisons and report interaction without calling them improvements. External final remains unopened.
